# Documentation Policy

- Document implemented behavior and established architectural decisions; label
  future work as planned.
- Update existing documentation instead of creating competing sources of truth.
- Update `README.md` for user-facing setup or extension behavior and `docs/`
  for architecture, language support, tooling, or governance decisions.
- Governance-only changes do not require a product changelog entry or version
  bump. Product-visible version changes require the version policy review.
- Store enduring architecture audits under `docs/architecture/`.
